request: Rank the 4 best Audi R8 generations overall across the full production run. Use 4 different generations when available, with one representative version from each generation. If the model has fewer than 4 true generations, use the most important era-defining versions across its history.
title: RANKING THE BEST AUDI R8 GENERATIONS
close_narration: Which R8 would you park in your garage: the V8 original, the V10 powerhouse, or the modern performance marvel?
order_rationale: Ranked by weighted enthusiast desirability, driving engagement, historical significance, performance, collectibility, and value—not chronology.

entries.name: First-Gen R8 V8
entries.label: ORIGINAL ICON
entries.one_line_fact: Let's rank every Audi R8 generation. At number four, we have the first-gen R8 V8, introduced in 2006. With its legendary side blade design, it entered the supercar scene at just $109,000, pushing 420 horsepower. Today, it still captivates with its iconic style, valued around $86K.
entries.ranking_case: As the inaugural model, it introduced Audi to the supercar arena, combining performance with daily usability.
entries.current_value_note: Recent Cars & Bids examples trade around $86K.

entries.name: First-Gen R8 V10 Plus
entries.label: PERFORMANCE BOOST
entries.one_line_fact: Then Audi turned up the volume with the first-gen R8 V10 Plus, debuting in 2012. Featuring carbon fiber side blades, it transformed into a beast with 550 horsepower. At $170,000, it was an expensive thrill ride; now, it's a $260K appreciation icon.
entries.ranking_case: This variant elevated the R8's performance credentials, offering a more aggressive driving experience.
entries.current_value_note: Recent Cars & Bids examples trade around $260K.

entries.name: Second-Gen R8 V10 Performance
entries.label: MODERN MARVEL
entries.one_line_fact: Next, the second-gen R8 V10 Performance, introduced in 2018. It became a modern marvel with 620 horsepower and a revamped honeycomb grille. Originally $195,000, it evolved with cutting-edge tech but said goodbye to some of the visceral thrills.
entries.ranking_case: This model represents the pinnacle of R8 evolution, blending cutting-edge technology with exhilarating performance.
entries.current_value_note: Recent Cars & Bids examples trade around $180K.

entries.name: Second-Gen R8 V10 RWS
entries.label: REAR-WHEEL DRIVE
entries.one_line_fact: Topping our list is the second-gen R8 V10 RWS from 2017. At $140,000, it paired purist rear-wheel drive with a striking red stripe. With 540 horsepower and a price drop to $110K, it’s all about pure driving pleasure, unlike anything else Audi offered.
entries.ranking_case: As the first rear-wheel-drive R8, it catered to driving purists seeking a more engaging experience.
entries.current_value_note: Recent Cars & Bids examples trade around $110K.
